title: Initiative app automation block
description: The `automation` block of an Initiative app manifest: the nodes an app contributes to the automation catalogue. Initiative stores this block verbatim and gives it no meaning; the automation service parses it, and this schema is generated from the rules that service enforces. Schema-valid is necessary, not sufficient — four cross-reference rules are not expressible here and are checked with the whole manifest in hand: a trigger field's `matches` naming an output of its own node, a node's `operation` naming one this manifest serves, a trigger's `event` being one this manifest declares, and an operation's `requires` naming a connection it declares.

contract.description: The contract version. A block naming a higher one is refused whole rather than read as if it were this shape.

domain.description: The drawer this app's nodes sit in. It carries no id: the drawer is always `app.<public_id>`, derived from the registration, so a publisher-chosen id cannot collide with a built-in drawer.

localizedText.description: Text keyed by language tag. At most 40 entries are kept and each is truncated to 120 characters; an entry that is not a string is ignored rather than refused, so one bad translation does not cost a node.

output.description: One value this node carries out, for a later node to bind with `$from`. Typed so that a binding can be refused when the automation is saved rather than discovered when it runs.

type.description: The field vocabulary minus `select`: a select is a control, and the value behind one is a string.

list.description: Several values rather than one. A list output cannot be bound into a field that takes a single value.

field.description: One control in this node's form. The same closed set a connection's fields use, so one renderer draws both. `secret` is absent and stays absent: a node's config is stored in a graph and shown in an editor, and a credential belongs in a connection.

matches.description: Triggers only. The output of this same node that this field filters on — equality for a scalar, containment for a list. Omitted, it defaults to the field's own key; a field matching nothing is refused, because a filter that can never match is a dead control.

category.description: `logic` is absent: flow control is resolved from a graph's edges rather than by calling anything, so there is nothing for an app to serve.

icon.description: Advisory. An unrecognised glyph falls back to the app's own icon rather than dropping the node.

event.description: Triggers only. Must be one this manifest also declares in `events` — checked with the whole manifest in hand.

operation.description: Conditions and actions only. Must name an operation this block serves — checked with the whole block in hand.
Where a condition or an action is served. A path on the app's own service, never an address: the base URL comes from the registration the deployment holds.

requires.description: Connection ids that must hold a value before this operation can be called. Exactly one operator; each id must name a connection this manifest declares.
